messages:
maya (Partner Eng): FYI partner CI surfaced a regression tied to driver 24.1 + CUDA 12.2: quantized workloads show ~15-25% higher p95 and occasional kernel OOMs. Looks like kernel selection is routing to the new matmul path that isn't stable with our quant code.
aj (HW Partner): Confirmed on our side. Nightlies fail two matmul tests, error `E matmul_kernel_v2: launch failed (cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources)`. Stack points to kernel selector mismatch.
kevin (Runtime Eng): Reproduced locally. When selector picks matmul_v2 we see the regressions; forcing fallback to matmul_v1 restores latency and stability. I can add a temporary selector override flag.
sofia (Marketplace): Current marketplace AMIs are on driver 23.7. We should avoid flipping the default until we have a tested canary. Any pin we do for the canary must be documented in the release notes so customers doing unmanaged driver updates aren't surprised.
maya (Partner Eng): Proposed actions: (A) runtime hotfix to reinstate legacy kernel path behind a toggle (release 24.1.1) (B) build `edge-driver-23-7` marketplace image pinned to driver=23.7.2 + cuda=12.1.x (C) partner CI matrix + limited canary bake (D) if green, promote to stable image and publish rollback/playbook. Target: hotfix + edge image within 48h, stable bake in 72h.
olivia (PM): Need a comms plan and partner sync cadence. Also confirm SLA impacts and any cross-region differences.
aj (HW Partner): We'll run the extended matrix tonight and upload logs to s3://partner-regressions/2299998765. Recommend pin to driver 23.7.2 for canary.
kevin (Runtime Eng): I'll open PR runtime#1012 with new runtime flags: `rc.force_legacy_matmul=true` and `rc.selector_canary=true`. CI will exercise both selector paths and add a perf baseline check. Aim to have PR and CI results in 6-8 hours.
sofia (Marketplace): Marketplace ops: can create an `edge` track image tagged `marketplace/redwood-inference:edge-23-7-<sha>` and schedule a 5% EU bake once you give the sha. Will need partner/legal sign-off if this touches managed fleets.
deploy-bot: Marketplace bake scheduled for `marketplace/redwood-inference:edge-23-7` at 2026-03-23T03:00:00Z. Notification will post to #eng-releases when complete.
maya (Partner Eng): Quick rollback playbook draft for partner ops:
```
rollback steps:
1) route traffic to driver=23.7 pool (100%)
2) set runtime flag `rc.force_legacy_matmul=true` on all agents
3) run smoke perf tests (latency p50/p95, a small eval suite)
4) monitor errors and latency for 1h; if >5% regressions escalate to incident
5) if rollback >4h prepare joint customer advisory
```
olivia (PM): I added a calendar invite for a cross-org sync at 16:00 PT today. I'll draft the embargoed partner note once we have CI and partner matrix results.
aj (HW Partner): Partner team will share matrix outputs by 22:00 PT. We'll flag any tests that still fail with current driver.
kevin (Runtime Eng): Adding smoke/perf checks to CI and will attach perf diffs to the PR. If CI passes tonight we can push the canary tomorrow morning.
sofia (Marketplace): I'll prepare packaging docs and a short migration note for customers that self-manage drivers.
maya (Partner Eng): Thanks all. If anything blocks the 48h plan, post updates here and I'll escalate to partners. :thumbsup:
